# Vendored upstream

- Project: Dualsense-Multiplatform / GamepadCore
- Source: https://github.com/DrapNard/Dualsense-Multiplatform
- License: MIT
- Imported: 2026-08-08

The source is intentionally vendored instead of fetched during Unreal builds. This keeps project builds reproducible and allows packaged plugins to build without network access.

Local integration patches must be kept minimal and documented in `Docs/VENDOR_PATCHES.md`.
